description: Create Zaq.Agent.Tools.DataSource.UpdateDocumentPermissions using Zaq.Engine.Workflows.Action and the validated shared Ingestion dispatch path; add explicit data_source.update_document_permissions Registry exposure for agents. Input: provenance-bearing record plus grants and revocations. Output: schema-defined target/affected result. Preserve workflow/agent trusted identity; unsupported providers fail explicitly. Verification: schema conversion/validation, tool registry, agent and workflow execution, permission denial and domain-error propagation. Depends on the shared mutation primitive.

comments.text: Implemented Zaq.Agent.Tools.DataSource.UpdateDocumentPermissions and Registry key data_source.update_document_permissions for agents and workflows. Added JSON schema conversion/refinements, CRUD-only projection-safe rights, public read-only safety, and unsupported-provider errors. JidoConnect follow-up: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/784

Corrected Action boundary: UpdateDocumentPermissions now uses DataSourceTool.dispatch/5 and :data_source_update_permissions on Channels. It does not call Ingestion. Source rights use ResourcePermission semantics; Ingestion remains projection-only.

title: [zaq-mc1.2] Add data-source permission Action
